clips.title: The story
paras: Talen needs the Ring of Zoram to open an ancient statuette found on the strand. The naga have taken the ring to their island sanctuary.

Talen believes the Ring of Zoram can open the ancient statuette recovered from the coast. Before the Great Sundering broke Kalimdor and sank its coastal cities, powerful night elven nobles ruled Zoram. The ring belonged among their regalia. After the cataclysm, it vanished beneath the waves for millennia, keeping the secrets of sunken relics from curious eyes.

Naga have recently come to the Zoram Strand and begun searching the ruins of their former homeland. Ruuzel, who leads the local brood, found the Ring of Zoram and took it to her sanctuary on an island to the north. Talen, a night elf, asks Alliance travelers to hunt Ruuzel and reclaim the heirloom so he can open the statuette recovered from the shallows.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I fear the ancient statuette's secrets will remain forever hidden unless you find the key to its ancient lock.
That key is a ring, the Ring of Zoram. It belonged to the rulers of this city before the waves of the Sundering drowned it.
For years the ring was lost, but the naga have recently found it.
Their leader, Ruuzel, dwells on an isle on the northern edge of Zoram. Please, friend, retrieve the ring for me!

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is said that the Ring of Zoram is the key to any lock within the city. Do you have it, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found the ring! Thank you, friend. Please take this as payment, and know that your deeds today will remain forever in my memory.
